teaser: You reach for the right gauge of wire on the hardware store pegboard before the clerk finishes the sentence — you already know which one the circuit needs. Life path 11 and ENFJ both run on reading what a room needs before it says so aloud. Eleven carries a heightened pitch of intuition bordering on static; ENFJ carries a gift for seeing what people could become and pulling them toward it. Crossed, the pull to guide others doubles, not louder, just more constant. What is particular here is how much of your own steadiness gets spent making someone else's path clear.
excerpt: Does the person across the table know when you are performing warmth and when you are simply warm?
